cards.title: See the month-end checklist beside the chat
cards.description: Maipa can open the close checklist next to the conversation: which months are closed, and for the date you want to close, every draft, unposted statement line and unreconciled statement still open. It reads your books live and changes nothing.

cards.title: A month-end checklist before you close
cards.description: Ask Maipa whether a month is ready to close. It checks for draft entries, statement lines without a posted entry, bank statements that are not reconciled, and the soundness of every entry, and tells you exactly what is outstanding. Closing the books stays your decision.

cards.title: Long conversations keep working
cards.description: A conversation used to stop accepting messages once it grew very long. Now the oldest messages move to a stored archive and you can keep talking to Maipa. Nothing is deleted. A line above the conversation says how many earlier messages are stored; viewing them in the app is not available yet.

cards.title: Discard a draft entry
cards.description: A draft entry you do not want no longer lingers in your books. Ask Maipa to discard it, or Maipa will ask when you decline one. After you approve, the draft is set aside, nothing is posted, and the statement line it came from is free for the corrected entry.

cards.title: Why cash and profit differ
cards.description: The cash flow now explains the gap between your profit and the change in your bank balance: what you have earned or owe but not yet received or paid, and cash moved by things like equipment, loans and owner money. Comparing two periods also shows the difference in cash.

cards.title: See where your cash went
cards.description: Your financial statements now include a cash flow: what your bank and cash accounts held at the start and end of the dates you choose, and what was received and paid in between, by account. Ask Maipa where the money went.

cards.title: Maipa’s building blocks are up to date
cards.description: The published components Maipa is built from, including the one that connects your Claude or Codex account, were updated to their latest releases. Nothing changes in how you work.

cards.title: See your income statement and balance sheet beside the chat
cards.description: Ask Maipa to show your results for any dates. The income statement and balance sheet open beside the conversation and always read the current posted figures from your books.

cards.title: Keep a report as a pinned view
cards.description: Ask Maipa to keep a report, such as this year’s results, and it is pinned for you. A pinned view remembers only the books and the dates, so it shows current figures each time you open it.

cards.title: Update cards are a slim banner
cards.description: The update card is now a wide, short banner in line with the conversation, so it takes much less room until you dismiss it.

cards.title: What's new no longer covers the chat
cards.description: These update cards now sit in their own strip under the header instead of floating over the page, so they no longer hide the Connect button, the message box or the Account menu. Dismiss them and the strip disappears.

cards.title: See your statements and reconciliation beside the chat
cards.description: Ask Maipa to show your bank statements or a reconciliation. The list says what each statement still needs before it can be reconciled, and the reconciliation shows bank against books, the open items and the exact difference, read live from your books.

cards.title: Record a bank reconciliation
cards.description: When a statement agrees with your books, you can approve recording that you reviewed it. Maipa keeps the figures as they stood and tells you if later changes alter them. A statement with any difference cannot be recorded.

cards.title: Add balances to an earlier statement
cards.description: A statement imported without its opening and closing balance can have them added, so it can be reconciled. They are accepted only if the statement's lines add up from one to the other.

cards.title: Maipa can reconcile a bank statement
cards.description: Ask Maipa whether your books agree with a bank statement. It compares the statement's closing balance with your books, lists the statement lines not yet posted and the entries the bank has not shown, and tells you the exact difference if any remains. It only reports; it changes nothing.

cards.title: Tie an earlier statement to its bank account
cards.description: A statement imported before Maipa recorded bank accounts can now be tied to its account afterwards, with your approval. Its lines can then be matched, marked as repeats and reconciled like any other. No entries or amounts change.

cards.title: Processor payouts in one entry
cards.description: A payout from a payment processor can now be recorded as one entry: the net amount into your bank, the fees as an expense, and the full sale as income. Before, an entry had to total exactly the bank line.

cards.title: Reversed entries free their statement line
cards.description: If an entry made from a statement line is reversed, the line now shows as needing an entry again, and Maipa can match it to the corrected entry. Before, it stayed marked as posted.

cards.title: Overlapping statements are not booked twice
cards.description: If two statements of the same account overlap, the repeated lines are no longer booked a second time. Maipa asks you to approve marking each repeat, showing both lines side by side. Two identical lines on one statement stay two transactions.

cards.title: Transfers between your accounts are booked once
cards.description: When you move money between two of your bank accounts, it appears on both statements. Maipa now books it as one entry and matches the second statement line to it, so a transfer is never counted twice or mistaken for income.

cards.title: Attach a PDF statement
cards.description: You can attach a bank statement as a PDF. Maipa reads its text and works out the transactions, then asks you to approve them. The card shows every row and the statement's opening and closing balance.

cards.title: PDF rows must add up
cards.description: A PDF import is refused unless the rows add up exactly from the opening balance to the closing balance, and every amount actually appears in the document. A scanned PDF without text cannot be read.

cards.title: Larger statement files are accepted
cards.description: Statement files larger than about 64 KB were being refused, although the limit shown is 512 KB. CSV and Excel statements up to the full 512 KB now upload, both in the chat and in Bookkeeping.

cards.title: Approval cards show the whole request
cards.description: A long description on an approval card is no longer cut off part-way, so you can read everything Maipa is asking you to approve. Maipa is also told to keep its own working notes out of its replies.
